text:
tariq: Hey team — small runtime PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3245. Fixes a KV prefetch race when batch size spikes + a tiny attention-kernel ordering tweak. I rebased onto main but CI is flaky. Hoping to merge in the next 2 hours if no objections. PTAL @maya @andrew @liz

maya: Quick skim done. Code looks fine at a glance. Tiny nit: prefer explicit assert in the prefetch path. I'll drop one inline comment.

andrew: I can take a full pass in ~30m. If CI is flaky we can queue for a short hold, but this looks low-risk.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Build started for PR #3245 — matrix: py38-gcc, cuda13.1

maya: Left a comment: change `if not kv.prefetched:` helper to be explicit. Not a blocker.

liz: I can run a staging smoke after merge. @tariq, does this require a model restart or rolling workers?

tariq: No restart needed — it's an ordering/fallthrough fix in the prefetch codepath. I resolved a rebase conflict in `kv/cache.py` earlier. One CUDA job is failing intermittently on CI.

andrew: That CUDA tiling test has been flaky — I can rerun the job. If green I'll approve.

ci-bot: ci-bot: cuda13.1 job failed: tests/attn_tiling_test.py::test_multihead_timeout — rerun queued

tariq: Re-run requested. @andrew if you can approve after green i'll merge. I'll hold redeploy until Liz confirms smoke.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: merge queue updated: PR #3245 added to queue (owner: tariq).

andrew: CI passed on rerun. LGTM — approving now.

maya: LGTM as well. The nit can be fixed in a follow-up if you prefer to merge now.

liz: Smoke on staging: ran `scripts/stress_prefetch.sh --runs 50` against canary, no regressions observed. Go ahead and merge in the next 15.

tariq: Thanks all — merging now after bumping changelog. Will monitor metrics and revert if anything odd pops up. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR #3245 merged by tariq. Canary rollout scheduled.
